scripts.deploy:android: cross-env APP_TARGET=android eas update --branch production --platform android
scripts.deploy:ios: cross-env APP_TARGET=ios eas update --branch production --platform ios
scripts.deploy:both: npm run deploy:android && npm run deploy:ios
scripts.build:android: cross-env APP_TARGET=android eas build --platform android --profile production
scripts.build:ios: cross-env APP_TARGET=ios eas build --platform ios --profile production-ios
scripts.build:both: npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
scripts.submit:ios: cross-env APP_TARGET=ios eas submit --platform ios --profile production --latest
